title: Back To Ashes
description:
ExperimentGame is an experiment of connecting several old-school game classics - delivered by one person team.

Worlds Are Being Consumed By Unknown Force.Explore dead realms to find the way to save Your own.
Join the journey through dark, corrupted worlds and experience epic enemy encounters.

Key Features:
Grab the Weapon- learn skill based combat and work out own style.

Face the Fate- fight Your way through corrupted realms, experience Your world's future and face the power of Primordial.

Find Your Own Way - choose between different statistics, traits and randomly generated items to build unique gameplay which fits you. Discover a plethora of different bonuses, runes and other components, gaining unlimited spoils.

*Game has controller support but was initially designed to play with keyboard+mouse
description_short: Explore alternative realities while trying to save Your own from approaching annihilation. Dark fantasy rpg action game which will take You on a journey deep into the realms of Errent.
